verdict.rationale: Gusto ships its own AI features (Gus, payroll agents), so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can consume external MCP servers, and the axis applies. The evidence only shows the opposite role: Gusto runs its own MCP server, including a Multi-Client MCP, so outside tools like Claude and ChatGPT can connect to Gusto. Nothing shows users plugging third-party MCP servers into Gusto, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client story.
